host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authority.owner_direction: Execute the next stage and do not perform SHA verification.
authority.scope: Re-adjudicate only the existing lm_head carrier-deliverability HOLD; do not implement or authorize a custom kernel in this probe.

carrier.original_tied_weight_policy: The model.language_model.embed_tokens and lm_head Parameter stays tied and CPU-resident. The probe may create one unregistered BF16 CUDA mirror tensor, then must delete it before exit.

population.real_hidden_source: The last hidden state from the longest of all 11 frozen rendered prompts in one fresh formal C02 NF4 load.
population.memory_stress: Keep that prompt's DynamicCache alive while allocating and executing the CUDA mirror path.

measurement.cpu_gpu_correctness: same-load CPU tied lm_head versus an unregistered BF16 CUDA mirror on the same real hidden state
measurement.softcap_elision_check: argmax(raw logits) must equal argmax(tanh(logits/30)*30) independently on CPU and CUDA
measurement.performance_role: diagnostic only; this probe has no speed threshold and cannot establish Bottleneck or candidate value

preflight_revision: Before formal execution, static compilation found that the shared carrier loader requires replay.seed in addition to measurement.seed. The identical seed was added and both frozen timestamps were advanced; no model load or measurement attempt had started.

replacement_checks: required input presence and model manifest byte sizes
shape census reports one tied CPU lm_head call per output token and 21705 projected calls
direct same-load storage identity, device, shape, dtype, logits, token, memory, and structure checks

hard_gates: formal carrier contains 343 active NF4 modules and the original tied lm_head/embedding weight remains on CPU
the longest frozen prompt is selected from all 11 requests and its real final hidden state is finite
R5 peak allocated bytes plus exact BF16 mirror bytes projects below 7.5 GiB
live peak allocated bytes with the longest-prompt cache and CUDA mirror present remains below 7.5 GiB
same-load CPU and CUDA softcapped greedy token IDs are identical
softcap elision preserves argmax independently on CPU and CUDA
the original tied CPU weight identity and model structure are unchanged after mirror cleanup
telemetry is present and has no thermal or hardware throttle

decision.pass_boundary: A PASS authorizes a separate, freshly frozen lm_head A/B/C/D selection probe only. It does not authorize candidate implementation, performance claims, C02 reconnection, or deployment.
non_authorizations: board, llama.cpp, sm_100, or sm_120 extrapolation
